kind: independent source review and CPU integration validation, not model quality
scope: evaluate_three_arm prepare identity/deduplication and prospective second-review selection
review_workflow dispatch, original review preservation, adjudication, seal and read-only verification

findings.original_issue: Aggregate originally accepted a lock with only status and preparation/judgment hashes, without proving primary/secondary/adjudication coverage.
findings.resolution: Root added lazy verify_sealed_review invocation before arm aggregation and froze workflow.py. The read-only verifier reconstructs all final labels from preserved initial reviews and required adjudications.

findings.issue: A file-based workflow cannot prove cognitive independence or prevent a reviewer with whole-workspace access from reading PRIVATE artifacts.
findings.mitigation: Disjoint neutral reviewer IDs and fresh contexts, own-folder-only dispatch, explicit attestations, no exported assignment joins, and same-input candidate separation within each stage.

findings.issue: Structured disagreements can be compared mechanically; contradictory rationale prose cannot be semantically adjudicated by a plumbing helper.
findings.mitigation: Every structured label difference/flag/reference-defect flag is adjudicated, both original prose rationales are retained, and reviewers must flag uncertain or contradictory explanations.

findings.issue: Reference defects must not be silently relabeled after seeing outputs.
findings.mitigation: Nonzero unresolved or reference-defect count blocks sealing and scoring; amendments require new versioned evidence.

note: The final generic limits sentence in the CPU receipt predates the root integration wording: WF-1 is now fixed, and the evaluator actually invokes the full verifier as proven by the integration fixture. Historical receipts are preserved unchanged.
